notes.title: Season 1 Playtest!
notes.content:
- Increase of Max Player Level to 20
 - Checkpoints at every 5 floors instead of every 10
 - Introduction of chests that require keys to unlock containing some random items. Higher the floor, more keys needed, more items to loot!
 - Floors 20-40 have some interesting new content, new enemies. After 40, the scaling returns to infinite. This will change throughout the season.

notes.title: Build 0.2.4: Season 1 pre-patch testing
notes.content:
Mostly just the current demo build with the demo restrictions lifted.

Updated from last base version:
 - UI overhaul
 - Multiplayer inventories responding correctly
     - One caveat: a time bug where clients redux actors actually recharge faster than they should, still looking at it.
 - Introduction of the first miniboss at floor five, with the floor fifteen one still removed until season 1.

notes.title: Playtest of the Demo Build!
notes.content:
Full UI overhaul, lots of bug fixes, some new content but this build stops at floor 5 to be the test of the demo restrictions.

Bug fixes!
 - Multiplayer inventories should NOW be safe, will be testing in this build. (this was a HUGE problem in season 0)
 - Tweaks to stat scaling
 - Some stat gems were not calculating correctly
 - Settings were not correctly saving everytime
 - Tutorial inventory now carries over to your first run
 - You can skip the tutorial by turning around and exiting the level - get right to the action

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.55: The Forge Update
notes.content:
New Content:
 - Forge added!	
 	You can now make level 1 armor and upgrade armor from the forge using iron ingots
 	You can smelt iron ore to iron ingots and craft iron ingots to iron keys (to be used later)
 - Sounds!
   Some pretty noticeable sounds were not included at launch... They are now included.

Bug fixes:
 - Optimization & Stability updates: Some data was incorrectly referenced which lead to some 'fatal error' crashes.
 - Scoreboard corrections: Multiplayer scoreboards would have duplicate names and inaccurately show damage/kills
 - Fixed an issue where client players were not getting healed when levelling up
 - Fixed an issue where more than 4 players could join a game, or players could join an in-progress run.
 - Game data files will go through a conversion on install of 1.55. If you have any issues, reach out at overturnstudios.com or the Steam discussion pages.

Thank you for the patience and the interest in Gifted! Will continue to improve things as the season continues.

Happy excavating!

You can smelt iron ore to iron ingots and craft iron ingots to iron keys (to be used later)
Some pretty noticeable sounds were not included at launch... They are now included.

notes.title: Version: 0.1.9
notes.content:
Mostly housekeeping this time :)

Patch notes:
 - Removed a work around for adjusting the maze exit, please report any unbeatable mazes! *
 - Gold will now show in the item feed
 - Item feed to fade unless relevant information is added to feed (or player paused)
 - Spawning enemies and items in store area has been corrected for clients
 - Spawning enemies and items in stairs and larger blocked areas has been corrected for clients
 - Small health potions now Give 25% as promised if you have more than 1200 max health
 - Slight buff to heal ability to tie over until ability overhaul in next update
 - Slight buff to fire ability to tie over until ability overhaul in next update
 - Some default Character lighting has been added
 - Defeating the mighty Dergen now awards XP
 - Dergen's fire will now disappear when defeated*
 - Skeleton's attack collision disables when defeated*
 - Level up particle reduced in brightness, levelling is logged in the item feed.
 - Cooking menu now shows required agents
 - Fixed Ult accidentally firing on L1 press instead of both bumpers*

 - Please note performance, benchmark some framerates, I am attacking performance soon. :)
